lines.l: The morning found me miles away, with still a million things to say
Now, when twilight dims the sky above, recalling thrills of our love
There's one thing I'm certain I'll return, I will, to old Brazil.
The morning found me miles away
With still a million things to say
Now, when twilight dims the sky above
There's one thing that I'm certain of
I'm not going to cry like that
I'm not going to cry like that
